blocks.html:
The Laboratory of Modern Languages (LLM) is the Language Centre of the Università della Svizzera italiana (USI). It is part of the "Services for Education, Student Life and Internationalisation" area, providing support for language learning within the broader framework of academic services, student life, and internationalization.

It organises and coordinates practical language courses in Italian, French, German, and English, designed to strengthen and deepen language proficiency through the four essential skills: listening and speaking, reading and writing. Language learning is further enriched by academic and specialised courses, as well as courses preparing students for language certification exams.

The programme offers courses from A1 to C1 level according to the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR). Courses are free of charge for all members of the academic and administrative community of Università della Svizzera italiana.
USI Alumni, students enrolled at other Swiss universities and external participants may enrol on the courses for a fee, subject to availability. Fees and registration procedures are available on the website.

The LLM also hosts the official Goethe-Institut examination centre of Italian-speaking Switzerland and collaborates with the DELF DALF examination centre for Grigioni and Ticino.

Since 2023, the LLM has also been a member of the Association of Language Centres of Swiss Higher Education Institutions (SSH-CHES-CSUS) and the European Confederation of Language Centres in Higher Education (CercleS), thereby strengthening its network of partnerships and fostering the exchange of expertise with other organisations active in language teaching and education.
